in_marathi.name: Jasvinder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God is Gracious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jasvinder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jas means gracious and Vinder means God. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jasam' which means gracious and 'Vindra' which means God. It is a powerful and meaningful name for a boy.
